Name: (CP) Atlas Of Paths
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
This mod will add many more paths to spruce up your farm, town, and anywhere you can place paths!

Currently there are 9 extra paths and 1 set of stairs, all placeable like paths, walkways, and outdoor floors.



These Paths can be obtained using my custom catalogue [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35658]AtlasV Collection Catalogue[/url] or spawned in using a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJBCheats[/url].


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ is REQUIRED for this mod to function (although who doesn't have Content Patcher?)

Please report any bugs you find in the "Bugs" tab, it makes it so much easier to track and fix issues.


[u]Planned:
[/u][list]
[*]Support for various recolours.
[/list][list]
[*]Grass Paths that change with the seasons.
[*]More paths based on vanilla paths.
[*]Entirely custom paths,
[*]Possibly requests from people like you!
[/list]

Thank you to all the lovely people in the Stardew Valley Discord who helped me figure out many things I became stuck on!

Downloads.Description: Added 2 new paths, and added 2 missing sets of stairs. See changelog for more details
